{{Top|leg}}
'''Blue Squadron''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] serving the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Garosian]] rebel [[Alexandra Winger]] experienced a recurring [[Dream/Legends|dream]] of flying an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] with Blue Squadron as [[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]], under the command of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] identified as [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]].<ref name="MtZ">{{JournalCite|3|Mission to Zila}}</ref>

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> Winger had joined the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]] with Blue Four [[Chaz Hunter]] as her [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]]. Blue Squadron participated in a patrol for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] following information from [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Intelligence|Intelligence]], during which Winger was ambushed and captured by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandei]]'s [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Judicator/Legends|''Judicator'']]. Blue Squadron's X-wings would later provide air support for [[Dair Haslip]]'s [[Battle of Janara III|rescue]] of Winger from Imperial custody on [[Janara III]].<ref name="SoG">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/shadesofgray/index.html|text="Shades of Gray"|int=Shades of Gray|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
